rule_en: Past simple = a finished time (yesterday, last week, in 2020, ago). Present perfect = a past action still linked to now (just, already, yet, ever, never, since, for).
rule_bn: নির্দিষ্ট অতীত সময় বোঝালে past simple; কাজটি এখনো প্রাসঙ্গিক বা সময় অনির্দিষ্ট হলে present perfect।

sessions.title: Spot the Error
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the wrong word, then choose the fix.

items.prompt_en: I have deployed the new flow to production yesterday
items.explain_en: 'Yesterday' is a finished time, so use past simple 'deployed', not present perfect.

items.prompt_en: I worked at Salesforce since 2019 and still love it
items.explain_en: 'Since 2019' links the past to now, so use present perfect 'have worked'.

items.prompt_en: We have fixed that bug last week before the release
items.explain_en: 'Last week' is a finished time, so use past simple 'fixed', not present perfect.

items.prompt_en: Did you ever broken the production build by mistake
items.explain_en: 'Ever' with the past participle 'broken' needs present perfect: 'Have you ever broken'.

items.prompt_en: He has joined the standup call two hours ago
items.explain_en: 'Ago' marks a finished time, so use past simple 'joined', not present perfect.

items.prompt_en: I knew my manager since I joined the team in 2021
items.explain_en: 'Since I joined' links the past to now, so use present perfect 'have known'.

items.prompt_en: Our team has shipped two releases last sprint
items.explain_en: 'Last sprint' is a finished time, so use past simple 'shipped', not present perfect.

items.prompt_en: We used this Salesforce flow since the last release
items.explain_en: 'Since the last release' links the past to now, so use present perfect 'have used'.

items.prompt_en: I have written the incident report last night
items.explain_en: 'Last night' is a finished time, so use past simple 'wrote', not present perfect.

items.prompt_en: She led the team since January
items.explain_en: 'Since January' links the past to now, so use present perfect 'has led'.

sessions.title: Choose & Fill
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the correct option or chip.

items.prompt_en: I ___ the deployment to production yesterday.
items.explain_en: 'Yesterday' is a finished time, so use past simple: finished.

items.prompt_en: She ___ already merged the pull request, so we can review it now.
items.explain_en: 'Already' with a result that matters now needs present perfect: has merged.

items.prompt_en: We ___ this Salesforce flow in 2021, but it still works fine.
items.explain_en: 'In 2021' is a specific finished time, so use past simple: built.

items.prompt_en: ___ you ever seen a production outage during a release?
items.explain_en: 'Ever' (any time in your life up to now) takes present perfect: Have you ever seen.

items.prompt_en: I ___ at this company since 2019.
items.explain_en: 'Since 2019' means it started in the past and continues now, so present perfect: have worked.

items.prompt_en: I can't merge yet because I ___ the tests.
items.explain_en: 'Yet' (not done up to now) pairs with present perfect: haven't run.

items.prompt_en: He ___ the bug report two hours ago.
items.explain_en: 'Two hours ago' is a finished time, so use past simple: sent.

items.prompt_en: The team hasn't finished testing the new API ___.
items.explain_en: 'Yet' pairs with present perfect for something not done up to now.

items.prompt_en: I ___ never coded in Python, only in Apex.
items.explain_en: 'Never' (not at any time in life) takes present perfect: have never coded.

items.prompt_en: When I was a junior, I ___ long hours debugging.
items.explain_en: 'When I was a junior' sets a finished past period, so use past simple: worked.
